```python
val_accuracy_history = [obs.value for obs in trial.metrics.get_history(name='val_accuracy')]
```

or 
```python
val_accuracy_history = [float(obs) for obs in trial.metrics.get_history(name='val_accuracy')]
```

Let me fix this by extracting the values from the MetricObservation objects.
